fact: The Minister for Public Service and Administration approved and issued the Minimum Interoperability Standards (MIOS) v5.0 for Government Information Systems in September 2016, prescribing data format and technical standards for exchanging data between government systems, mandatory for national and provincial departments.
title: Minimum Interoperability Standards (MIOS) for Government Information Systems, Revision 5.0
publisher: Department of Public Service and Administration
